## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a large and heavy-set twenty-year-old youth. He features a round, stolid face that lacks expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a large, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He suffers from a notable lack of conversational skills.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## History

Billy drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Following Anne's successful recitation and supper after the event, he drove the group back in his carriage as the girls chatted about the night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) is Billy's sister. The siblings attend social events together, such as providing carriage transportation for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to and from the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
